name: ruralrise
description: RuralRise — Local Opportunity, Local Prosperity. Full-stack platform connecting rural youth in India with opportunities, training, schemes and local markets.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
